      "subtasks": [
        {
          "id": "1.1",
          "title": "Add ten_second() factory method to RollingAverage",

        },
        {

          "title": "Add test for 10-second rolling average",

      ]

    {

          "updated_at": "2026-01-02T23:01:40.143528+00:00"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "phase-3",
      "name": "Extend MetricsCalculator with cadence smoothing",
      "description": "Add RollingAverage instances for cadence and wire them into the process() method",

          "title": "Add cadence RollingAverage fields to MetricsCalculator",

          "status": "completed",
          "tests": [],

          "updated_at": "2026-01-02T23:03:55.534678+00:00"
        },
        {
          "id": "3.2",
          "title": "Process cadence through rolling averages",
          "file": "src/metrics/calculator.rs",
          "description": "Update process() method to calculate cadence_3s_avg and cadence_10s_avg when cadence is available, converting between u8 and u16 as needed",
          "status": "completed",
          "tests": [
            "test_cadence_smoothing"
          ],

        },
        {

          "tests": [

          "updated_at": "2026-01-02T23:08:48.886537+00:00"
        }
      ]
    },

      "name": "Add UI metric types for cadence averages",
      "description": "Extend MetricType enum and add display support for smoothed cadence values",

          "updated_at": "2026-01-02T23:12:22.749304+00:00"
        },
        {

          "title": "Add Cadence3s and Cadence10s cases to render_metric",

          "description": "Handle MetricType::Cadence3s and MetricType::Cadence10s in the render_metric() method of RideScreen",

Follows the same pattern as the existing Cadence case. Committed as c366367.",
